source.title: Reframing dopamine: A controlled controller at the limbic-motor interface.

confidence_rationale: A computational model of active avoidance/omission in which the prospect of punishment is RECAST as an opportunity to approach safety, with accumbens dopamine transients tracking that reframing at discriminative cues. This is a near-isomorph of MECH-358's threat-gated approach bonus toward credited escape-affordance classes. Strong mechanism-level mapping; held below 0.8 because the model targets dopaminergic control, not REE's pure-arithmetic per-action EMA table.
failure_signatures: The model treats reframing as a deliberately deployed cognitive-control instrument; if REE's bridge bonus fires non-selectively (not threat-gated) it would diverge from this account, which makes the threat-context gate a load-bearing guard.

mapping.source_claim_statement: When instrumental and Pavlovian influences conflict (active avoidance, omission), a controlled reframing mechanism recasts possible punishment as an opportunity to approach safety; modulation of accumbens dopamine is itself an instrument of cognitive control, and the fitted model reproduces observed dopamine transients at discriminative cues.
mapping.ree_translation: The 'approach safety' reframing is MECH-358's approach bonus: under future threat, a per-candidate negative (favoured) E3 score-bias toward credited classes drives the agent to approach the escape affordance. The discriminative-cue dopamine transient is the moment the threat-context gate opens and the credited class is favoured.
mapping.mapping_caveat: This is a normative/dopaminergic model, whereas MECH-358 is a non-trainable arithmetic regulator with explicit clamp/gate/leak guards; the mapping is at the level of computational role (reframe-to-approach-safety), not implementation. MECH-375 (trainable Q_relief) is the closer REE analogue of a learned controller.
mapping.source_context: Model fit to rodent behaviour + accumbens dopamine from two active-avoidance/omission datasets.

confidence_components.notes: Computational role maps cleanly onto the approach-bonus term; implementation differs (learned dopaminergic control vs fixed arithmetic).
